seo: Support tone of voice and policy rules
meta: Your tone and policy rules written down in plain words so every support reply follows them. From $50, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Tone and policy rules for consistent support replies
overview: A reply tool is only as good as the rules behind it. We interview you, read your past replies and policies, then write a clear rule set covering tone, wording to use and avoid, what can be promised and what must go to a person. It is delivered as a ready-to-paste instruction document and a one page summary for your team, and we test it on sample questions.

faq: Do you need my existing policies?
It helps a lot. Send what you have, even rough notes. If a policy is missing we ask you questions and draft wording for you to approve, since we cannot invent your rules.
Where do I use the finished rules?
Paste the instruction text into your chat helper, help desk assistant or reply drafting tool. We tell you where it fits for the tool you use.
Can the rules prevent every wrong promise?
They reduce risk by stating what may and may not be said, but no tool is perfect. That is why we also list the cases that should always go to a person.
